Self-criticism and self-compassion: why being less harsh can come before being kinder.

The usual advice about the inner critic is to be kinder to yourself. But research on self-compassion suggests the harsh side and the kind side are not mirror images, and the harsh side is more closely linked with distress. Researchers have suggested that for people in a lot of distress, easing the harsh side may be a useful place to start.
